 Auditor 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

  

Elections & Voter Registration 

Conducts all elections held in the County and maintains voter registration records. 
 
 
General Election:  First Tuesday after the first Monday in November in even numbered years.
 
 
 
 
 
City & School Election:  First Tuesday after the first Monday in November in odd numbered years. . 
 
 
 
Special Election: On an as needed basis 
 
 
 
Primary Election: First Tuesday after the first Monday in June in odd numbered years 
 

Election Security in Iowa https://vimeo.com/280607200 

  
Register to vote or update your voter registration.  You may click here for electronic voter registration or click here to download the printable form.  

  

Voting Rights Restoration: Click here to learn how to have your voting rights restored following a conviction of a felony. 

  

Voting in Iowa  http://www.iowacounties.org/about/communications-center/isac-voting-in-iowa-videos/

Real Estate/Taxation 

Maintains property ownership records in the county. Determines levies and certifies property taxes to Treasurer based on valuations and certified local budgets.
 
Search Historical Records 

Budget 

Prepares County's annual budget. Conduit for other local budgets filed with State.(Schools, cities, townships, etc.) 

  

Payroll/Accounting 

Performs payroll and related functions for County, performs HR duties and maintains record books of revenues/Expenditures of County, issues payment for claims approved by Board of Supervisors.
 

 
 

 This link leads to the machine-readable files that are made available in response to the federal Transparency in Coverage Rule and includes negotiated service rates and out-of-network allowed amounts between health plans and healthcare providers. The machine-readable files are formatted to allow researchers, regulators, and application developers to access and analyze data more easily. 

  

Clerk to Board of Supervisors 

Prepares agenda and notifies media of meetings. Attends board meetings and records official board proceedings. Publishes minutes. 

  

Passports 

As agent, assists in completing and mailing applications for passports as issued by the US Department of State. 

  

Other Duties 

Official Custodian of courthouse under direction of Board of Supervisors. Issues beer, liquor & cigarette permits on behalf of State of Iowa for unincorporated areas of county.
